meta.title: Features: a real Chrome for your agents, on your own server · easi.run
meta.description: Everything easi.run does: a real Chrome your agents drive over MCP or REST, one-click takeover, encrypted session vaults, live sound, files and clipboard, per-session proxies, on your own server with no usage fees.
title: Features.
intro: Everything your agents and you get from a real Chrome on your own server: a person one click away, logins that stay logged in, files and sound that reach you, and every control in your hands.
takeover.title: Your agents browse like a person
takeover.text: Claude Code, Codex or any agent drives a real Chrome. Sites see an ordinary browser. At a login, you step in; your agent waits, then carries on.
vault.title: Your logins, locked in a vault
vault.text: Log in once and stay logged in. Sessions live on your server, encrypted with your password, and open from any computer.
mcp.title: Plugs into Claude Code and Codex
mcp.text: A built-in MCP server, over HTTPS with a token, or right on your server with none. The installer adds it to Claude Code for you.
api.title: A plain REST API too
api.text: The same tools over HTTP, with a token per agent. Revoke a token and it’s refused at once, then its sessions stop.
sees.title: Sees the page, then acts
sees.text: The agent reads the page’s accessibility tree and its screen, then clicks, types and scrolls through the screen’s own pointer and keyboard, not scripts in the page.
steps.title: Many steps, one call
steps.text: Batch clicks, typing and checks that wait for the page into a single call, or run a short script. Long tasks take fewer round trips.
watch.title: A live link to every run
watch.text: Every session your agent starts comes with a watch link. Open it to see the browser live, and take over right there.
own.title: Each agent sees only its own
own.text: A token reaches the sessions it started and the saved logins you allow it. Never your settings, your other tokens or the live view.
parallel.title: Several browsers at once
parallel.text: Each session is a Chrome of its own. The installer works out how many your server’s memory runs side by side.
duration.title: No clock running
duration.text: A session runs until you or your agent stops it. No hourly meter, no plan limit on its length.
lend.title: Lend a login, not a password
lend.text: Pick which agents may resume each saved session. They work logged in as you; to every other agent, it doesn’t exist.
live.title: Crisp text, smooth motion
live.text: Moving parts stream as AV1 video, and the page sharpens to pixel-perfect once motion stops. A still screen sends no new frames.
sound.title: Hear the page
sound.text: The page’s sound plays live in your browser, with its own volume and mute.
drop.title: Drag files onto the page
drop.text: Drop files from your computer straight onto the page, with real progress right where you dropped them.
picker.title: Your own file picker
picker.text: When the page asks for a file, your computer’s own picker opens.
downloads.title: Downloads land in your Downloads
downloads.text: Files stream to your computer as the page writes them, byte for byte. A page saved with Save as arrives whole, in one file.
clipboard.title: Copy and paste both ways
clipboard.text: Text moves between the page and your computer with your usual shortcuts.
keyboard.title: Any keyboard, any language
keyboard.text: What you type arrives as text, so accents, input methods and every layout just work. On a Mac, ⌘C and ⌘V do what you expect.
record.title: Record with your camera
record.text: Record the session on the server in high quality, with your camera and microphone if you like, straight into your Downloads.
screen.title: Fits your screen
screen.text: A session you start takes the real desktop size closest to your screen’s shape. One click takes it full screen.
together.title: Watch together, one at the wheel
together.text: Open a session in several windows. One holds control; the others watch, and take it with one click.
connection.title: Your connection at a glance
connection.text: A live panel grades your link and shows the frame rate, traffic, delay and codec.
languages.title: Speaks your language
languages.text: The admin, this site and the docs come in 11 languages. Pick one, or follow your browser’s.
redact.title: What you type stays yours
redact.text: After you take over, the exact text you type or paste, four characters or more, reaches the agent as [redacted], and screenshots stop. Password fields never reach it.
sandbox.title: Every browser in its own sandbox
sandbox.text: Its own containers, no network of its own, no privileges, a read-only system and a strict seccomp filter.
private.title: Your network stays off-limits
private.text: Sessions reach the public web on its usual ports. Your private network and your server’s own services stay out of reach.
stealth.title: Sites see an ordinary Chrome
stealth.text: Real Google Chrome in a real window, with WebGL on and no automation flag. Clean on BrowserScan, sannysoft and rebrowser.
proxy.title: Your proxy, its time zone
proxy.text: Send each session through a proxy you pick, checked before use, with a time zone and languages suggested from where it exits. Name lookups go through it too.
signin.title: Two-step sign-in
signin.text: Guard the admin with an authenticator app or a passkey, plus one-time recovery codes. After a few wrong guesses, the wait between tries grows.
switches.title: Switch features off per session
switches.text: Turn off input, clipboard, uploads, downloads, sound or recording for a session. The server enforces it, whatever the client sends.
fresh.title: A fresh, locked-down Chrome
fresh.text: Each session starts from a clean profile unless you resume a saved one. Extensions, file:// pages and the password manager stay off.
pinned.title: Every image pinned
pinned.text: Each image is pulled by its exact digest, and Chrome comes straight from Google’s signed repository.
install.title: Install with one prompt
install.text: Ask Claude Code or Codex to install it, or run one command. Updating and uninstalling take one command each.
tuning.title: Tunes itself on install
tuning.text: The installer tunes TCP with BBR when your kernel has it, sizes sessions to your server’s memory and sets up the UDP media path.
port.title: One HTTPS port, no TURN
port.text: Everything rides one HTTPS port. Where UDP gets through, video and sound take it, and fall back on their own when it doesn’t.
light.title: Light on bandwidth
light.text: In our benchmark, scrolling streams at 55 fps in 1.8 Mbit/s, where KasmVNC needs 12.4 Mbit/s for 24 fps.
fees.title: No usage fees
fees.text: No hourly bills, no price per session. You pay for your server, and nothing else.
open.title: Open source you can audit
open.text: AGPL-3.0, everything around the browser. Read every line that touches your sessions.
closed.title: Off the open internet
closed.text: The admin answers only on your server itself. Reach it through an SSH tunnel, or Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel.
sdk.title: Make it yours
sdk.text: Build your own takeover screen with the viewer SDK, serve your own client, and show your logo on every session’s screen.
demo.title: Try it right now
demo.text: A real Chrome on my server, live on my first page. No sign-up, no install.
